summary: Assign exported class constructor to namespace.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: construct
tests.input: namespace N { export class C { x=1 } }; console.log(new N.C().x);

tests.name: identity
tests.input: namespace N { export class C {} }; const C=N.C; console.log(C===N.C);
